_note: 1_06_01 'A Little Help' — Gary and Pete lead the player to the hobo behind the school; fetch his transistor radio, hand it over, and learn a fighting move (recon: docs/re-notes/ch1/1_06_01-a-little-help.md). The script is the whole hobo-lesson chain's template; v1 ports mission 1 only. v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 1-06/1-06B cutscenes are title card + speech beats; the radio sits at ground level by the stairs (the ladder climb is a traversal system we don't have); the button-SEQUENCE prompt is the v1 lesson framework — perform the named move N times within re-opening attempt windows (the original's per-button timing widget is a later wave); the trainer is a live sparring pawn (the original's 5000 hp + min-health + disarm are simplified); the player auto-walk outro is dropped. The game clock pauses for the lesson and unpauses on the outro, like the original. Pass grants (transistor collectibles enabled) live in the campaign table's on_pass for 1_06_01. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: A Little Help

stages.objective: Gary and Pete know a guy.

on_start.sub: Behind the school, they say, lives a fighting man.

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: There's a guy behind the school who knows every move in the book.

lines.speaker: PETE
lines.text: He's a little strange, but he helped us out once.

stages.objective: Follow Gary and Pete behind the school.

lines.speaker: HOBO
lines.text: Who's that? Come to mock an old soldier?

stages.objective: Find the hobo's radio by the stairs.

on_start.speaker: HOBO
on_start.text: Fetch me my radio first. Dropped it by the stairs.

on_complete.text: transistor radio collected (item 476; the original's ladder climb is pending a traversal system — ground-level stand-in)

stages.objective: Bring the radio back to the hobo.

on_complete.speaker: HOBO
on_complete.text: Ahh, music to my ears. Right — you wanted to learn to fight.

stages.objective: Learn the move: three good jabs.

on_start.speaker: HOBO
on_start.text: Show me your jab. Three good ones. Go!

lines.speaker: HOBO
lines.text: Not bad, kid. Come back when you find another one of those radios.

on_complete.text: campaign on_pass for 1_06_01 enables transistor collectibles (SMissPass equivalent; Halloween1 dressing chain not built)
